# Lab 15.4: Visualise Graph Results

## What We Are Going to Do
Show graph query results as an interactive network in a BigQuery notebook.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open a notebook.** Create a new notebook and connect a runtime (Lab 9.1).

2. **[Console] Draw a path.** The query must return whole graph elements, converted to JSON:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">%%bigquery --graph
GRAPH lab15.FinGraph
MATCH p = (person:Person {name: 'Dana'})-[own:Owns]-&gt;(src:Account)-[t:Transfers]-&gt;{1,3}(dst:Account)
RETURN TO_JSON(p) AS path</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Explore.** Drag nodes, click a node or edge to see its properties, and zoom in and out. Different labels get different colours.

4. **[Console] Draw the whole graph.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">%%bigquery --graph
GRAPH lab15.FinGraph
MATCH p = (a)-[e]-&gt;(b)
RETURN TO_JSON(p) AS path</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Magic | `%%bigquery --graph` |
| Return type | Graph elements as JSON |
| View | Interactive network |
| Use | Explain relationships visually |
